thread:
tara: quick brain dump about a simpler failover handshake that also enforces residency flags. want quick takes before i file a follow-up RFC. :wave:

devin: quick sketch pls :)

tara: idea: make the proxy handshake minimal: (1) control-plane issues short-lived "region-lease" JWTs per-tenant (claims: tenant, region, exp, seq), (2) proxies include that token in `X-Region-Lease-JWT`, (3) any write attempt checks JWT validity + residency claim. If mismatch -> 409 + `lease_conflict`.

hiromi: JWTs make signature verification cheap. But how do we prevent two proxies from both getting valid JWTs simultaneously (race during renewals)?

tara: renew flow: proxy requests renew with `If-Seq: <last_seq>` to avoid blind renews. control-plane refuses if it sees higher seq from another region. We also keep a short "renew-window" (e.g., 8s) for operator overrides.

sam: What about reads that use cached KV contexts? We can't always re-run; latency-sensitive paths need best-effort. Proposal: tag cache entries with `lease_seq` and `lease_jwt_kid`. On read, if JWT kid != current control-plane kid -> mark as "stale-read" and increment metric. Also attach `Warning: 199 stale-lease` header for observability.
